registration_example.claude_code: claude mcp add dce-cad -- python "G:\My Drive\Google AI Studio\.agents\tools\mcp_dce_cad_server.py"

tools: render_cad_plan(sheet_type, output_dxf_path, template_path, pdf_path, model_json_path, dry_run)
edit_entity(session_dir, source_dxf, handle, dx, dy, expected_revision, dry_run)
_note.scratch_policy: Virtual Drive Guard: local fixed NTFS/ReFS C:/D: only. Optional DCE_CAD_SCRATCH_ROOT; unsafe overrides fall back to local Temp. PNG destinations are always redirected; use output_png/preview_id from the response.
_note.vision_lifecycle: render_preview -> consume_preview returns image content and automatically deletes the PNG; direct file readers call release_preview after inspection. Abandoned completed previews expire after 24h and are swept on the next allocation. Edit revisions are retained.
